summary: The test suite is exceptional. It achieves comprehensive coverage by combining Pester unit tests for the core matrix logic, static structure tests for the GitHub Actions YAML file, and fully isolated end-to-end integration tests using `act`. The custom act test harness elegantly sets up temporary git repositories to validate exact workflow execution outputs, strictly fulfilling all complex testing constraints. Edge cases like partial exclusions, standalone includes, missing configurations, and max-size validations are thoroughly verified. The test design is modular, clean, and highly robust.
